name: Interactive Pivot Tables for Large Relational Tables

mentions.name: Interactive Pivot Tables for Large Relational Tables
mentions.description: This system creates interactive pivot tables from very large relational tables, supporting tables with thousands of columns and hundreds of millions of rows. Dropping a CSV, JSON, or other file onto a window creates a table, and a pivot table can then be built in a few clicks; it pivoted an 8.5-million-row Chicago crime dataset in under a second. Each cell maps to its underlying row keys, so double-clicking a cell instantly shows the original rows used to compute it for further analysis. It has been tested against 25M, 50M, 100M, and 200M+ row tables, going beyond spreadsheets' million-row limit.
mentions.problem: Excel pivot tables are limited by spreadsheets' one-million-row cap, and working around it requires jumping through hoops, making interactive analysis of very large datasets impractical.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Creating interactive pivot tables from large relational tables.

Many people know that a handy data analysis feature in Excel is to create a pivot table from a spreadsheet. But spreadsheets are limited to just a million rows. You can get around this limit by jumping through a bunch of hoops.

My system lets you easily create tables with thousands of columns and hundreds of millions of rows. (Just drop a CSV, Json, or other file on a window to create a table.)
